config.name: local_predict10
config.training_objective: single-point adversarial handoff with optional D-only local auxiliaries
config.particle_policy: one fixed z per real episode, shared across sampled positions
config.memory_timing: real observations strictly before target; same M for real/fake scoring
config.penalty_domain: candidate coordinates only; same cached real memory; exact default B-cap

config.name: feedback_p100
config.training_objective: local adversarial handoff with optional detached single-write feedback and D auxiliaries
config.particle_policy: one fixed z per real episode, shared across sampled positions
config.feedback_gradient: generated replacement detached; D writer retains gradients
config.feedback_target: original next real point as recovery target
config.memory_timing: strictly before target, optional replacement of last observation; same M for real/fake scoring
config.penalty_domain: candidate coordinates only; same cached memory; exact default B-cap
